text:
Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. The requirements specification has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261105-105313-feature-new-text-range-styles/requirements.md` covering:

- **Explicit Assumptions & Gate 0 Decisions**: Whole-element last-writer-wins reconciliation (`reconcile.ts` and `delta.ts` off-limits), frozen write contract, absent-when-empty field representation to preserve existing snapshots, range boundary extension rules, and UTF-16 code-unit indexing against `originalText`.
- **In scope (`IS-1`–`IS-8`) & Out of scope (`OOS-1`–`OOS-8`)**: Numbered, testable boundaries aligned with the approved intent brief.
- **Functional requirements per module (`FR-1`–`FR-16`)**: Traceable requirements across `packages/element` (`types.ts`, `textStyles.ts`, `index.ts`, `newElement.ts`, `textElement.ts`, `listMarker.ts`, `renderElement.ts`) and `packages/excalidraw` (`textWysiwyg.tsx`, `App.text.ts`, `App.duplicate.ts`, `actionProperties.tsx`, `Actions.tsx`, `en.json`, `restore.ts`, `staticSvgScene.ts`, `CHANGELOG.md`).
- **Non-functional requirements (`NFR-1`–`NFR-5`)**: Zero regression for unstyled text, immutable updates for history delta tracking, performance fast-paths, repo convention compliance, and restore sanitization.
- **PII inventory & Role matrix**: Client-side data sensitivity and editor/collaborator/view-mode permission matrix.
- **Acceptance criteria (`AC-1`–`AC-6`)**: Executable unit, jsdom integration, restore/reconcile, SVG export, and full suite (`yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false`) verification criteria.
